_comment: Between-level cinematics (scripts/interlude_cinematic.gd, docs/CUTSCENE_SCRIPTS.md). Keyed by the floor just finished. voice = Niro over the remote (niro_<hash> clip); thought = Miro (miro_<hash> clip, Thought bus).

1.title: LEVEL 2
1.speaker: THE VOICE
1.voice: You have the remote. Keep it close, and keep quiet.
1.thought: Someone is guiding me down. I should find out why.

2.title: LEVEL 3
2.speaker: THE VOICE
2.voice: If you go any lower, I can't protect you.

3.title: LEVEL 4
3.speaker: NIRO
3.voice: Now you know my name. Please, stop at the records.
3.thought: Brother. The word feels true, and I hate that.

4.title: LEVEL 5
4.speaker: NIRO
4.voice: Don't come down here, Miro. Please.
4.thought: The seals, the supports. Everything rests on the floor below.
